title: About Brian and Gina Kingdeski — Green Light Buying Machine
description: 26 years, 2,300 deals in the Phoenix metro, and the system built out of all of it.
heading: Brian and Gina Kingdeski
lede: 26 years, 2,300 deals in the Phoenix metro, and a system built out of all of it. The program is small on purpose — you work with the people whose names are on the book.

blocks.body:
Brian and Gina Kingdeski have been fixing and flipping homes together for 26 years. They've done north of 2,300 deals in the Phoenix metropolitan area alone — through markets going up, markets crashing, and markets recovering.

They've made great decisions and expensive mistakes, lost sleep over deals, and woken up to checks that changed things. What came out of all of it is a system: deal by deal, house by house, what it actually takes to build a co-living business that holds up.

They also own Trinity Design and Construction, which is where the build standards came from — the co-living work sits on top of a construction company, not a marketing company.

They wrote the system down in The Green Light Buying Machine and they teach it directly — by phone, by email, and if you're in Arizona, they'll come walk a house with you.

blocks.heading: Why we teach it this way

columns.body:
Most real estate education is sold to people with no experience, because that's the biggest audience. It's also why so much of it doesn't work — you can't teach someone to run a renovation in a video course.

We went the other direction. We only take people who can already build, then we solve what they're actually missing: which houses convert, what standard to build to, and who buys the finished product.

We'd rather you think of us as coaches than teachers. A teacher delivers information. A coach watches you apply it, corrects you when you're off, celebrates the wins, and pushes when you need pushing.

That means we're actually available — by phone, by email, and in Arizona we'll come walk the house with you. The goal was never for you to understand this. It's for you to do it.

blocks.heading: Students say
blocks.body: Add two or three testimonials from students who have closed. Ask each for the before and after: what their retail exit looked like, and what the co-living deal did.
